name: asb-platform
_workspacesNotu: Glob (packages/*) yerine açık liste: packages/app bir Flutter paketi, npm ile yönetilmiyor. Yeni bir npm paketi eklerseniz buraya elle ekleyin.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@asb/shared-types && npm run build --workspace=@asb/backend
scripts.dogrula: npm run build --workspace=@asb/shared-types && npm run typecheck --workspace=@asb/backend && npm run lint --workspace=@asb/backend && npm run test --workspace=@asb/backend
scripts.dogrula:app: cd packages/app && node -e "require('fs').rmSync('ios/Flutter/ephemeral',{recursive:true,force:true})" && flutter analyze && node -e "require('fs').rmSync('ios/Flutter/ephemeral',{recursive:true,force:true})" && flutter test
